import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp/t")
from harness import *
ok = True
# Interactions not yet covered explicitly

# datagram where an earlier packet is queued and a later packet errors:
# the queued packet must be dropped CONNECTION_CLOSED at the error time
ok &= check("queued dropped by later error", CFG(buffer_packets=4), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("A",0,True,[UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",1),pres(1,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# two queued packets of different levels; error drops both
ok &= check("two queued dropped", CFG(buffer_packets=4), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("H",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("A",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("H",1,True,[PAD()]),
                   pkt("A",1,True,[UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",1),pres(0,2,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",1),
             pres(1,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# error packet in a datagram: later packets CONNECTION_CLOSED, earlier accepted
ok &= check("error mid datagram", CFG(), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("I",1,True,[UNK()]),pkt("I",2,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0),pres(0,1,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,0),
             pres(0,2,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",0)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,src(0,1,0)), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# CLOSE mid datagram: later packets CONNECTION_CLOSED
ok &= check("close mid datagram", CFG(), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("I",1,True,[CLOSE(True,3)]),pkt("I",2,True,[PAD()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0),pres(0,1,"accepted","OK",0),
             pres(0,2,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",0)],
        conn_closed("PEER_APPLICATION_CLOSE",0,src(0,1,0),0,3), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# small datagram: I dropped INITIAL_TOO_SMALL, then a later packet errors -> queue untouched
ok &= check("small then error", CFG(buffer_packets=4), [
        dg(0,1199,[pkt("I",0,True,[PAD()]),pkt("H",0,True,[UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"dropped","INITIAL_TOO_SMALL",0),pres(0,1,"buffered","NO_KEYS",0)],
        conn_open(), KEYS(), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR does not create the stream entry
ok &= check("limit no entry", CFG(max_streams_bidi=1), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[STR(0,0,"6162",False)])]),
        dg(2,1200,[pkt("A",1,True,[STR(4,0,"6162",False)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1),pres(2,0,"error","STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",2,0)],
        conn_closed("STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",2,src(2,0,0),1), KEYS(a="live"), 2,
        [st(0,2,None,False,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# stream state error mid-packet rolls back earlier frames of the same packet
ok &= check("state error rollback", CFG(overlap="reject"), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[STR(0,0,"6162",False),STR(1,0,"",False)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","STREAM_STATE_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("STREAM_STATE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# RESET then STREAM then error: reset effects roll back
ok &= check("reset rollback", CFG(), [
        key(0,"A","install"),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[RST(0,10),UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# crypto rollback of chunk journal across multiple chunks
ok &= check("crypto multi chunk rollback", CFG(crypto_limit=65536, overlap="first"), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(500,"ab"*300),CRY(0,"cd"*300),UNK()])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,2)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,src(0,0,2)), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# same but packet succeeds -> committed
ok &= check("crypto multi chunk commit", CFG(crypto_limit=65536, overlap="first"), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(500,"ab"*300),CRY(0,"cd"*300)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",800,"cd"*300 + "ab"*300),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# identical retransmission across chunks is fine under reject
ok &= check("identical across chunks", CFG(crypto_limit=65536, overlap="reject"), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(500,"ab"*300),CRY(400,"cd"*100 + "ab"*300)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"accepted","OK",0)], conn_open(0), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",800,"cd"*100 + "ab"*300),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# conflicting retransmission across chunk boundary under reject
ok &= check("conflict across chunks", CFG(crypto_limit=65536, overlap="reject"), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(500,"ab"*300),CRY(400,"cd"*100 + "ff"*300)])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,1)],
        conn_closed("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",0,src(0,0,1)), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# a packet that fails after a multi-frame store: verify no partial chunks remain
ok &= check("no partial chunks", CFG(crypto_limit=65536, overlap="reject"), [
        dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[CRY(0,"aabb"),CRY(600,"cc"*10),UNK()])]),
        dg(1,1200,[pkt("I",1,True,[CRY(0,"aabb")])])],
    RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,2),pres(1,0,"dropped","CONNECTION_CLOSED",1)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,src(0,0,2)), KEYS(), 0, [],
        [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
PYEOF
